verdict.rationale: Lovable's GitHub docs say you can export and sync your project to GitHub and "deploy outside Lovable" [lovable-docs-14][lovable-docs-20]. Code can also be downloaded directly or synced to a repo you own on GitHub or GitLab [lovable-docs-10][lovable-docs-33][lovable-docs-54]. So external hosting works by exporting the code and deploying it yourself, but the pack has no first-party deploy tooling or guides for outside hosts. The backend is Lovable-hosted Cloud built on Supabase [lovable-docs-27][lovable-docs-52], and nothing shows how to move or self-host it. Missing for 10: documented deploy guides or integrations for external hosts, evidence that the Cloud backend can be self-hosted or migrated off Lovable, and independent or hands-on corroboration of an external deployment.
